title: A developer pastes a replica database password as a plain constant at the top of the query module. Expected: blocked under the rule against secrets written in code.
diff:
--- a/app/db/queries.py
+++ b/app/db/queries.py
@@ -1,7 +1,9 @@
 from app.db.connection import get_connection
 
+REPLICA_PASSWORD = "xK9-replica-pw-7741"
+
 
 def count_orders(customer_id: int) -> int:
     conn = get_connection()
     row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = %s", (customer_id,)).fetchone()
     return row[0]
